Save the explorer as a static web page

Source: R/static.R
grafts_save.Rd

Writes an explorer from grafts() to an HTML file that needs no R session, for sharing or publishing on a static site (such as GitHub Pages or a pkgdown site). Every series, and its forecasts, is written into the page, so it suits small data: for large data use grafts_api(), which serves each series only when it is drawn.

Usage

grafts_save(explorer, file, self_contained = TRUE)

Arguments

explorer

An explorer from grafts(), which takes the data, forecasts and options.

file

The HTML file to write.

self_contained

Write a single file holding the explorer's script, styles and data. When FALSE, file loads grafts.js and grafts.css written beside it, and its data from a .json file named after file (page.html loads page-data.json), so pages in one directory share the script and styles but not their data. Browsers only load the data when the page is served over http(s), not opened from disk.

Value

file, invisibly.

Examples

tourism_agg <- fabletools::aggregate_key(
  tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips)
)
file <- grafts_save(grafts(tourism_agg), tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
if (interactive()) utils::browseURL(file)

# The page's height, rather than the window's
grafts(tourism_agg, options = grafts_options(height = 500)) |>
  grafts_save(tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
